Lena / Tim / Marissa — adding technical details for the auditor pack. Please consider the following as the canonical responses we can include in your vendor evidence bundle. Feel free to copy/paste into your SOC prep docs.

1) EU-only hosting (Tenant pinning) - For private and dedicated accounts we support region pinning by tenant. When pinning is enabled the control plane enforces routing and placement constraints; no automatic cross-region replica or failover will occur unless the customer requests disaster-recovery configuration. We can provide the tenant_record and placement_policy excerpt upon request.

2) Private control plane and connectivity - Redwood Private offers two modes: (A) Customer-managed control plane deployed into the customer's VPC (recommended for air-gapped/regulatory customers) and (B) Redwood-hosted private control plane with PrivateLink endpoints into the customer's VPC. Both options restrict the management plane to private subnets and the data plane to configured VPC endpoints; egress to public internet is disabled by default for private deployments.

3) KMS (BYOK) and key isolation - We support BYOK with per-tenant key references. Keys can be stored in customer-managed KMS (e.g., Cloud KMS/Azure Key Vault) or Redwood-managed HSM-backed keys with logical tenant partitioning. Logs referencing key use are retained in your EU-based log store when tenant pinning is active.

4) Evidence artifacts - Attached: runbook (operational checks), network diagram (annotated with subnet/CIDR/endpoint types), and a KMS summary. If auditors need an export of placement rules or a signed attestation on letterhead, we will generate those as part of the pack.

Notes for Marissa/Alex: I drafted a 2-paragraph attestation below we can sign and convert to PDF. Confirm wording and I will send signed copy from Security.

--- Draft attestation (for approval) ---
Redwood Inference confirms that for tenant(s) operated by BioHealth Therapeutics, Redwood will enforce EU-only hosting for the specified tenant(s) when tenant pinning is configured. The Private deployment options include (i) customer-managed control plane in the customer's VPC and (ii) a Redwood-hosted private control plane with PrivateLink endpoints; both options avoid public-control-plane egress by default. Customer-provided keys (BYOK) are supported and, when used, key material and cryptographic operations remain logically partitioned per tenant.

This attestation is provided for use in BioHealth Therapeutics' SOC 2 readiness pack and is accurate to the best of Redwood's knowledge as of the date of issuance.
